Independent replication of clock-three-picture SPEC.md
Eigensolver: Householder tridiagonalisation + Sturm bisection; eigenspaces by
Gaussian elimination (complete pivoting) null space of H - lambda I; grouping tol 1e-7;
null-space pivot tolerance 1e-8. Residuals ||H b - lambda b|| reported.
Sanity: tau orthonormal: max |<tau_j|tau_k> - delta| = 2.48e-16
Sanity: max_k || e^{-i H_C t_1} tau_k - tau_{k+1} || = 8.89e-16
